location_description:
Middletown is a town in New Castle County, Delaware, United States. According to the 2010 Census, the population of the town is 18,871.


== Geography and climate ==
Middletown is located at 39°26′58″N 75°42′59″W (39.4495560, –75.7163207) with an elevation of 66 feet (20.1 m).According to the United States Census Bureau, the town has a total area of 11.61 square miles (30.1 km2), of which 11.61 square miles (30.1 km2) is land and 0.16% is water.
